title: A frame-shop pickup and weekend errand
titleZh: 裱框店取件與週末行程

documents.title: Customer collection card
documents.text:
Bring your order number to the front counter for pickup. Orders containing glass should be collected by car or on foot. If you come by bicycle, we can give you a wrapped frame only if it contains acrylic instead of glass. Staff will not replace glazing at pickup.

If an order contains several frames and you want only one, tell us which piece to bring out. The other pieces will stay on the same order, so keep the order number to use again. The step-free side door is for collections by people who have already checked in at the front counter by phone.
documents.textZh:
取件時，請把訂單號碼提供給前方櫃檯。含玻璃的訂單應開車或步行領取。若你騎自行車來，只有裱框內裝的是壓克力而不是玻璃時，我們才會交付已包好的作品。店員不會在現場換裝透明面板。

若一筆訂單有好幾件裱框，但你只想領其中一件，請告訴我們要取哪一件。其餘裱框仍保留在同一筆訂單，請保留原訂單號碼，下次還要用。無階梯的側門供已透過電話向前方櫃檯報到的顧客取件。

documents.title: Text exchange
documents.text:
Ivy: I can’t collect my two frames on Saturday. Would you pick up the one for the hallway? Order 618. The one with glass is for the bedroom, and I’ll collect that myself another day.

Ben: Yes. I’m going by bicycle. I prefer the side door because I’ll have the bike with me.

Ivy: The hallway frame has acrylic, so that works. Both frames are under that number. Please tell the shop you’re taking just the hallway one. Could you pick up one of their hanging guides too? Don’t buy any hooks; I have some at home.

Ben: Sure. I’ll call the front counter before I go around to the side.
documents.textZh:
艾薇：我星期六沒辦法去領兩件裱框。你能幫我領要放在走廊的那件嗎？訂單 618。裝玻璃的那件是臥室用的，我改天自己領。

班：可以。我會騎自行車去。我想走側門，因為會帶著車。

艾薇：走廊那件裝的是壓克力，所以沒問題。兩件裱框都用這個號碼。請告訴店家你只領走廊那件。你也能幫我拿一份他們的掛畫指南嗎？不要買掛鉤，我家裡有。

班：好。我繞到側門前會先打電話給前方櫃檯。
